name: 6 Jokers

features.name: Joker top reel
features.description: A joker wild appears on the extra reel each spin.

features.name: Multiplier bombs
features.description: A full joker reel unlocks additive multiplier bombs.

review:
A neon 6x5 with an extra, empty reel on top. Every spin, a joker lands somewhere on that top reel as a wild.

Winning symbols tumble away but jokers stay, and each cascade adds another joker up top. Fill the top reel and multiplier bombs can drop in during tumbles, adding together. An ante bet is available. Up to 5,000x and a 96.55% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
